pages.hook: A diner is a classic American restaurant with long counters, big menus and breakfast all day. Learn how to order eggs, pancakes and coffee with confidence.
pages.polite: Say **Yes, please** and **Thank you**. Servers often ask, **“Are you ready to order?”**

mythfact.s: Many American diners serve breakfast all day.
mythfact.why: You can often order pancakes and eggs in the afternoon.

mythfact.s: You only have one way to cook your eggs.
mythfact.why: The server asks: scrambled, fried (sunny-side up or over easy) or boiled.

mythfact.s: Pancakes usually come with syrup, often maple syrup.
mythfact.why: Syrup and butter are the typical toppings.

mythfact.s: In a diner, you pay before you sit down.
mythfact.why: In a diner the server brings the check at the end of the meal.

mythfact.s: Many diners bring more coffee to your cup.
mythfact.why: Refills of regular coffee are common in diners.

compare.us: In an American diner, breakfast can be big: eggs, bacon, toast, pancakes and coffee. It is often a sit-down meal with friends.
compare.tip: Learn the egg words: scrambled, fried and boiled. The server will ask!

pages.title: Reading quest — Breakfast with a hungry caterpillar
text: Good morning! I am in **Philadelphia**, and **I’m starving**. This morning, I walk into a small diner near my hotel. The sign says, “Breakfast all day.”

A server says, “**Table for one?**” I say, “**Yes, please.**” She brings the menu and a cup of coffee. “**Are you ready to order?**” she asks. I say, “**I’d like** pancakes and eggs, please.” “**How do you want your eggs?**” “Scrambled, please.”

The food comes fast. The pancakes are big and warm, with butter and syrup. The eggs are soft and yellow. I eat toast too, and I drink my coffee with milk. **This is delicious!** The best breakfast ever.

I think about a famous picture book, “The Very Hungry Caterpillar” by Eric Carle, from 1969. A tiny caterpillar is very hungry, and every day she eats more food. At the end she is not hungry, and she becomes a beautiful butterfly. I laugh. This morning, I feel like a very hungry caterpillar!
I pay the check and leave a tip. The server says, “**Enjoy your day!**” Now I am full, and I am ready for a walk in the city.
